overlay_diagnostics.unresolved_attribute_note: These are attribute-call names that the conservative source overlay could not bind statically. They include dynamic dispatch and other receiver-dependent calls; they are diagnostics, not resolved edges.

selection_note: Topology-only shortlist. Independent paths minimize hop count per seed; union selection minimizes unique directed edges. Paths containing ambiguous or cross-file unique-name edges are excluded; every retained edge is statically resolved or same-file name evidence. Query-conditioned weighted validation is still required.
